title: The story step in Hebrew
changes: The guided interview reads in Hebrew: the tabs across the top, the questions and their examples, the materials attached to a section, the events inside it, and the attribution labels on answers drafted from a document.
Resetting the story reads in Hebrew too, including how long ago it was cleared.
The reset confirmation said "all four parts" — it has been five since After the war was added. It now counts the sections rather than naming a number.
The family tree's opening line now reads המשפחה עליה הסיפור נסוב, and the sentence after it no longer repeats the same word.
